name: woocommerce
title: WooCommerce
description: Cart, checkout and order events from WooCommerce's own storefront DOM events, plus order data printed on the order-received page.

platforms.name: WooCommerce
platforms.notes: Cart and Checkout blocks. Classic themes are covered through the jQuery added_to_cart event.

options.name: events
options.description: Allow-list of commerce actions. Every action in the schema by default.

options.name: identifyUsers
options.description: Call setUser with the WordPress user ID.

options.name: includeEmail
options.description: Add the customer email to setUser.

options.name: includeName
options.description: Add the customer name to setUser.

options.name: actionPrefix
options.description: Rename the action prefix if the site has its own convention.

options.name: consent
options.description: auto reads the consent signal, ignore skips the gate, or supply a resolver callback.

options.name: beforeTrack
options.description: Edit or drop an event before it is sent.

options.name: dataGlobal
options.description: Global holding the server-rendered store, customer and order payload.

options.name: debug
options.description: Log every mapped event to the console.

footprint.consentSource: WP Consent API (via the consent option or a consent plugin)
